description: This file defines a Java interface 'WidgetLoader' which provides a contract for modules that register screen widget classes with the widget factory within the OFBiz framework. Implementations of this interface are expected to define the 'loadWidgets' method to perform the registration process.

classes.name: WidgetLoader
classes.description: A Java interface that specifies a method for registering screen widgets within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: loadWidgets
methods.description: Abstract method that, when implemented, should register screen widgets with the widget factory.
